judgment.explanation: 陳元方 is the courtesy name of 陳紀, the father of 陳長文 (陳羣) and brother of 季方 (陳諶). The main text mentions 陳元方 as the father of 長文 and brother of 季方. Both candidates c0 and c1 refer to the same historical person 陳元方/陳紀. c0 is preferred as the primary candidate.
諶 is the personal name of 陳諶 (季方), the brother of 元方 and father of 孝先 (忠). The 陳氏譜 annotation states 諶子忠, confirming 諶 is the father of 忠. The candidate matches this historical referent.
忠 is the personal name of 陳忠 (孝先), the son of 諶 (季方). The 陳氏譜 annotation states 諶子忠, confirming 忠 is the son of 諶. The candidate matches this historical referent.

assertions.interpretation: The scene opens with the present state of Chen Yuanfang's son Changwen being talented, establishing the contemporary context of the two cousins' debate.
The dispute cannot be resolved, marking the ongoing state of the argument at scene time.
The cousins consult Taiqiu (Chen Shi), the grandfather, to adjudicate the dispute — a subsequent step in the scene's sequence.
The Wei Shu identifies Chen Qun, courtesy name Changwen, providing biographical background context from the historical record.
Annotation notes that Changwen, when grown, had insight and judgment — a later biographical characterization distinct from scene time.
Annotation notes that those he associated with were all of his father's generation — background context about Changwen's social circle.

assertion.exact_span: 與季方子孝先各論其父功德
assertion.interpretation: The two cousins (Changwen and Xiaoxian) each argue about the merits of their respective fathers, which is the immediate event occurring at scene time.
assertion.surface: 與季方子孝先各論其父功德

assertion.exact_span: 太丘曰元方難為兄季方難為弟
assertion.interpretation: Taiqiu's verdict at scene time: Yuanfang is hard to be an elder brother to, and Jifang is hard to be a younger brother to — the concluding utterance of the scene.
assertion.surface: 太丘曰元方難為兄季方難為弟

assertion.exact_span: 祖寔嘗謂宗人曰此兒必興吾宗
assertion.interpretation: Liu Xiaobiao's annotation quotes the Wei Shu: Chen Shi (the grandfather) once told his clansmen that this child (Changwen) would surely prosper their lineage — a past prediction quoted as background precedent.
assertion.surface: 祖寔嘗謂宗人曰此兒必興吾宗

assertion.exact_span: 陳氏譜曰諶子忠字孝先州辟不就
assertion.interpretation: The Chen family genealogy identifies Xiaoxian as the son of Chen Chen (Jifang), courtesy name Zhong, and notes he declined a provincial appointment — biographical background.
assertion.surface: 陳氏譜曰諶子忠字孝先州辟不就

assertion.exact_span: 一作元方難為弟季方難為兄
assertion.interpretation: Liu Xiaobiao notes a textual variant of Taiqiu's saying with the roles reversed — an alternative reading of the same utterance, uncertain which is original.
assertion.surface: 一作元方難為弟季方難為兄
